summary.answer: Creates the selection instruction, specialist image and specialist name. Both character-dependent children subscribe to CharacterSelection.characterIndex and update only for nonnil model values. It registers close, conditionally calls PostLoadFunc and returns self. Character display lookup/rendering and the actual selection action remain external. Constructs CoD.NewSpecialistFooter from the displayed menu/controller/layout arguments. Creates SelForNewSpawn as LUI.UIText.new, SpecialistImage as LUI.UIFixedAspectRatioImage.new, SpecialistName as LUI.UIText.new. Connects 2 model/path references; the model subscription effects below specify which receiver changes and under which nil/value guard. Installs 1 event/action/override bindings; each callback keeps its captured controller/menu/widget references and executes only on its bound delivery. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.
